mapper.sql: id, task_id, version, is_latest, result, summary, problem_log, flight_hours, flight_count, reporter_id, reporter_name, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_report (task_id, version, is_latest, result, summary, problem_log, flight_hours, flight_count, reporter_id, reporter_name) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{version}, #{isLatest}, #{result}, #{summary}, #{problemLog}, #{flightHours}, #{flightCount}, #{reporterId}, #{reporterName})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_report WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND is_latest = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM task_report WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT MAX(version) FROM task_report WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_report SET is_latest = 0 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND is_latest = 1
